# EduPulse AI

> Local-first exam paper and blueprint generation suite for Indian school teachers.

- **URL**: https://edupulse.ai
- **Repository**: https://github.com/anujtiwari1427/quiz-ai
- **Architecture**: 100% Client-side Local-First (IndexedDB via Dexie, Web Workers, client-side PDF/DOCX export)
- **Primary Boards**: CBSE, ICSE, Maharashtra State Board, State Boards
- **Languages**: English, Hindi, Marathi
- **Privacy**: Zero server uploads. Textbooks, question banks, and generated test papers stay strictly on the user's device.

## Core Capabilities
- In-browser textbook ingestion (PDF, DOCX, TXT)
- Blueprint design (marks allocation, question type distribution, Bloom's taxonomy balance)
- In-browser LLM orchestration (Google Gemini client API with local BYOK API key)
- Split Question Paper & Answer Key Editor with live sync
- Export to high-res PDF and editable DOCX formatted to standard Indian school examination templates
